# Code Book

This file describes the variables in `secTidySet.txt`, which is the tidy dataset output.

## Identifiers

- `subjectId`: ID of the volunteer (1–30)
- `activityId`: Numeric ID of the activity performed
- `activityType`: Descriptive name of the activity (e.g., WALKING, SITTING)

## Measurements

The rest of the variables are the average values of the original mean and standard deviation features measured from smartphone accelerometers and gyroscopes. Examples include:

- `tBodyAcc-mean()-X`
- `tBodyAcc-std()-Y`
- `tGravityAcc-mean()-Z`
- ...

Each value is the average of that measurement for each subject/activity pair.
